topics.title: Open Defecation and a Moose Hotel Stay
topics.summary: During the WYSP Morning Show, Howard Stern recounts an incident involving public defecation on lawns and porch stays with a moose and squirrel, alongside bizarre interactions at a hotel service request. Jessica Han shares explicit details about her requests for services and suggestive comments while Richard Simmons reacts to video footage of The Stones concert traffic congestion.

topics.title: Deadhead Hotel Mayhem and Strange Encounters
topics.summary: During a radio show discussion, listeners recount chaotic experiences at Grateful Dead concerts involving extensive tent camping and bizarre interactions with fans including a "crazy Jerry" figure who heckled the host. Multiple weddings occurred simultaneously alongside accounts of wealthy fan Bob Weir advertising clothing, Mick Jagger meeting a distraught listener named Dannier, and unsettling incidents like someone crawling under a woman’s skirt in a hotel lobby.

topics.title: Marriott Mayhem & Nutrisystem Shenanigans
topics.summary: After a chaotic visit to the Marriott, old rockers experience enthusiasm and confusion while attempting weight loss with Nutrisystem. Calls involve punching Crazy Jerry, phone sex with Rachel the spanker, missing daughter concerns, and Scott Muny's lack of insight – culminating in an attempt to find Nutrisystem’s headquarters.

topics.title: Hotel Hijinks and a Naked Woman
topics.summary: A man recounts an incident at a hotel where a woman repeatedly exposed herself to multiple men, leading to uncomfortable interactions and accusations of inappropriate behavior. One man crawled under her dress, raising concerns about potential disease transmission.

topics.title: Parking Lot Chaos and a Movie Mishap
topics.summary: During a late-night broadcast, guests engaged in erratic behavior including indecent exposure and attempted assault within the hotel parking lot. Security intervened, leading to an abrupt departure of several individuals, notably Richard Simmons who refused to attend due to concerns about the environment. A subsequent segment involved discussing a planned movie starring Charles Nelson Riley and Vinny.

topics.title: Michael's Weight Loss Woes
topics.summary: During the show, Richard struggles to understand Howard’s excitement about Michael Abranco’s dramatic weight loss journey, leading to confusion over seating arrangements at a concert and misinterpretations of conversations. The hosts attempt to call in a celebrity guest while discussing Michael’s progress, resulting in humorous exchanges.
